text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's explore all kinds of places today!
Off to a marvelous expedition we go☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! There's a pattern drawn on this rock!
Could this be... Could it really be...?!☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Click... rumble rumble rumble!*)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, open, Marvelo~~~us!
Ahahahahahahaâ

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"An old shrine? A small shrine??
And... what is that stone monument—?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Herein recorded lies the Sea of Light bestowed by God"... !?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...So pretty. It's like the stars are smiling.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! It really is a sea of light!
Such a truly marvelous starry sky☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san...!!
Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was chasing Marvelous whoooosh down from that mountain
and ended up here☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That mountain over there... in just one day?
What kind of legs do you have?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
? Come to think of it, you might be right!
I used to be totally out of breath before, but now—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"...You know what?! Trainer and I fixed it!
How I swing my arms, how I lift my legs...
a whole bu~nch of tiny details!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then the speed builds up,
my body feels light... and it's totally marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
They're so easy to overlook,
yet every single one is important...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Your Trainer must understand you very well.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta tell everyone when I get back☆
I encountered so many marvelous things today!
And also—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks a bunch for making me stronger~~!!
...Just kidding ☆"
